people.name: Cornelius
people.line: Centurion, first Gentile convert to Christianity

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”
translations.bsb: So Peter went down to the men and said, “Here am I, the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
translations.kjv: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
translations.asv: And Peter went down to the men, and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
